findings_and_questions.status: Earlier original 774 finding, independently reconnected to current source; same conditional family, no new count
findings_and_questions.first_contract: A bearing passed to the surface validator should still have a nonempty admitted floor partition. The normal FloorBearing wire TryFrom and from_member use admit and reject an empty regions vector. Its fields are mutable inside the grounding module. If an already admitted bearing is altered there by clearing regions and subsequently reaches surface validation, validate_floors still checks bearing count and member identity, but validate_floor iterates no regions and computes zero absent, zero wrong area and zero perimeter-based allowance, so it returns Ok. The wire itself cannot deserialize an empty bearing through that constructor.
findings_and_questions.qualification: This is a source-level representable internal state and conditional path, not evidence that any actual production caller mutates such a bearing, nor that a supported scene accepts it. Other checks may reject an independently malformed surface. Exact original ROOT-ADM-G039 supplement already attributes this case to ROOT-ADM-F010; do not count as new. Surface bearing count/member identity check is real but does not recheck individual nonemptiness.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: Only after audit completion and later implementation authorization, consider sealing invariant-bearing state or explicitly re-admitting a complete mutated producer result at the owner boundary; preserve legitimate unoccupied scenes, precise floor/edge tolerance policy and typed causes. Trace real writers before prioritizing.

findings_and_questions.status: Prior central current conditional finding; supporting 95e source re-inspected, no independent new count
findings_and_questions.first_contract: Architectural wire transport retains original source polygon and reconstructs a rounded projected outline. Rigid projection and ordinary scene polygon admission intentionally differ: the prior central assessment gives a mathematically derived very-large-offset rounding concavity candidate, conditioned on the full producer, range and native consumer contracts. from_scene uses the strict scene constructor and must not be described as accepting that specific projected concavity.
findings_and_questions.qualification: Exact dyadic argument and source refs are preserved in prior/ASSESSMENT-ROUNDED-POLYGON-TOPOLOGY-95E.json. Native sin_cos identity assumption, supported 2^23m placement, complete recipe/admission/mesh and physical effect remain unproved; no geometry, test, fixture or native behavior executed. Preserve intentional small rounded-bend semantics.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: After audit and authorization, first determine supported projection domain and complete consumer topology, then choose a policy preserving valid rounded edges; no automatic re-hull or compatibility label.

findings_and_questions.status: Open API/source-owner question, not demonstrated defect and no unique count
findings_and_questions.observation: ground_generated_city compares existing scene placements, compounds, gardens, streets, yards and parishes against layout before selecting support. The public layout also retains single_properties, including property id, building id and plot, and single support consumes those records; the scene home catalog is separately checked against physical building identity and dimensions. The bounded dispatcher constructs that catalog and scene from the same building_layout and passes that exact layout to grounding.
findings_and_questions.qualification: The public API relationship and which layout-derived values are legitimate independent authoring inputs require further owner and caller inspection. No accepted mismatched layout, invalid geometry, bad gameplay, or divergence between home-catalog and CityPropertyId semantics is demonstrated. Membership/compound/projection and surface gates provide material safeguards and are not exhaustive coherence proof. This is related to 059 q1580/q1581 but exact alias identity is unresolved.
findings_and_questions.future_repair_direction: Document actual authoritative source and allowed independent inputs; if a supported divergent pair is established, bind or derive its identity at the selected owner, not by adding parallel fallback authorities.

nonfindings: FloorRegion retains private admission and derived outline; both factory paths pass through the same wire construction and expose an immutable view. No independently mutable duplicate authority is established. Architectural preservation is intentional source transport, not a legacy fallback.
No-building plus absent grounding is an explicitly valid scene mode; occupied scenes require projection and projection with no placements is rejected.

ground_generated_city consumes self, computes the selected/compiled result before replacing owned placements, and validates before returning Ok; local ordering does not prove partial publication through an external effect.
Surface validation checks ordered floor/member cardinality, mesh and geographic predicates; do not misstate this as proving each mutated bearing is nonempty.
The bounded dispatcher uses one layout for construction and grounding. It does not prove all possible callers or native consumers use that discipline.
Original 774/059 tests and test source displayed in this packet are evidence text only. No tests or product execution.
open_questions: Are there real grounding-internal writes that can invalidate a bearing before admission or retained surface use; are they reachable through supported APIs?
Which callers can supply layouts with different single-property identity, plot or support recipes while the compared scene fields match; what binds those fields to the intended source owner?
What actual product coordinate and recipe domains admit the prior extreme rounding example, and can fan/coverage consumers expose a supported physical mismatch?

Do all planned compound and single member producers faithfully populate each validated member before compile indexes the member map? Selected membership checks are insufficient by themselves to prove every downstream path.
Which original 059/774 and current owner obligations are first-failure aliases after exact cross-lens reconciliation; preserve distinct source-specific effects until then?
How are native serialization, physics and downstream terrain consumers admitted and bound beyond the registered bounded source ranges?

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Scene layout selects support and derives seated placements/projection; dispatcher inspected uses the same layout, while other producer entry points remain unassessed.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: FloorRegion/ScenePlanPolygon/PlanPolygon and typed scene points, property/building ids and support elevation express different physical roles. Raw native geometry at bounded clipping ports is not automatically an owner defect.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Wire and generated surfaces invoke validate_encoded; FloorBearing wire and factory use nonempty admit. Scoped internal mutation can defeat that leaf before re-admission under the explicitly conditional F010 case.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Rounding and subtraction/coverage operations need whole-domain proof, not blanket exact convex reparse of intentionally projected authored contours; prior large-offset candidate remains conditional.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Surface validates floor/member count and ordering and coverage/datum allowance; empty altered bearing does not accumulate missing coverage. No supported mutation path proved.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: Scene owns producer binding and physical placements; layout owns single/compound support selection; terrain and polygon types own their respective checked representations. The home catalog versus property support identity relation remains open.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Private FloorRegion admission plus readonly derived outline is coherent within inspected paths. Geographic and placement digests have distinct binding purposes, not proof of independent competing authority.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Keep optional empty scene, exact membership rules, rounded architectural source transport, tolerated perimeter-based edge area, and rejection before return. Do not add compatibility paths or eliminate intended zero modes.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: FloorRegionWire separates Scene and Architectural fields; optional grounding paired with occupancy is explicitly matched. No further semantic enum replacement follows from scoped body alone.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Serde conversion rebuilds invariant-bearing derived outline and preserves source authority, so a blanket derive replacement is unsupported. No macro/reflection execution or uninspected implementations claimed.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Differentiate floor region, floor bearing partition, property support surface, geographic source and scene projection; membership or finite leaves alone do not prove complete aggregate topology.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: Assigned functions contain typed errors and no private string protocol to replace. Dispatcher to_string is a native outward diagnostic boundary; error presentation consumers are outside this scope.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Zero building id and no-building modes have defined different meanings, and perimeter times contact tolerance is explicit geometry policy. Extreme floating coordinates require reachable-domain assessment, not speculative global limits.

limitations: No implementation, edits to product or publication checkout, tests, product/fixture execution, rendering, builds, probes or simulations. Offline hash, Git object membership and evidence verification only; ownership, final ledger and publication remain central.
